body.description: Pastor Abel, a tall gentle man in his fifties who keeps the church on the hill: short grey beard, a sun-faded blue work shirt buttoned to the collar, a small wooden cross on a cord, patched khaki trousers, a canvas bag of bread on one shoulder, kind tired face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
